description: S. Srihar and Others Vs. Urban Development Authority and Others S. Srihar and Others Vs. Urban Development Authority and Others View More before Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
parties: S. Srihar and Others Vs. Urban Development Authority and Others S. Srihar and Others Vs. Urban Development Authority and Others View More
judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioners sought to challenge the approved building plan and development permit issued by the 2nd Respondent on the directions of the 1st Respondent, on the basis that they are violative of the Rules and Regulations published in the City of Colombo Development Plan 2022-2031 under the Urban Development Authority Act; 2 nd Respondent proposed to utilise lesser than the permissible ground coverage and instead construct vertically to achieve the Floor Area Ratio (FAR). Held – Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
